other_conditions: Applicant or spouse must be a resident of the National Capital Territory of Delhi
Applicant must not be employed with Central/State Government or Local/Autonomous bodies
Applicant or spouse must not have previously availed the scheme
Attendant (if chosen) must be older than 21 years
benefits_summary: The Delhi government provides free travel, food, accommodation and related expenses for senior citizens (60+) and a single attendant.
